title: Only color the even-numbered rows of the data table
goal: Combines tbody and :nth-child() to select table rows by position.
summary: When browsing multiple rows of device records at a glance, alternating background colors can help focus on the current row. The header has an independent style.
tasks: Use #e6f4ee for the 2nd, 4th and other even-numbered lines in tbody.
The odd-numbered rows and table headers retain the existing background color, and do not add HTML class names.

example.note: nth-child starts counting from 1, odd means odd number, and even means even number.

hint: Write tbody tr:nth-child(even) to avoid treating the table header as a data row.
